第(1/3)页

见儿子这样急吼吼的，张淑芬便问道：“卫东，这么着急吗？明天再去县城不行么？

现在时间不早了，要不明天再过去吧？”

陈卫东却有些等不及道：“娘，时间来得及，我骑快点儿，能赶回来吃晚饭。

这件事还是早点办了，我能安心些。”

见儿子这么说，张淑芬也不再拦着了。

“你小子，就是个急性子。

我还以为你这段时间稳重了呢，没想到有时候还是有些急躁。”

陈卫东这是笑着道：“娘，没办法，这不是想着让咱们红旗生产队多挣点钱吗？”

他们家过上了好日子，陈卫东也惦记着带动着大队一起致富。

这样对他家好，对整个生产队都好。

听了儿子的话，张淑芬的脸上又不禁露出来了一抹自豪的笑容。

她养出来的儿子，不光能力出众，人品也没得说。

她这个当娘的，感到很欣慰和骄傲。

陈卫东则是蹬着自行车，飞快的朝着县城赶去。

到了县城，换了平时见彪哥的装扮后，陈卫东才去找上他了。

正好，昨天没出的一百多斤野猪肉，陈卫东顺道卖给了彪哥。

等卖完了野猪肉，陈卫东和彪哥提了缝纫机的事情。

他这次需要五台缝纫机，不知道彪哥这边能不能给弄到。

“兄弟，五台缝纫机我能帮着你弄到，不过可能需要点时间。”彪哥将情况说明了一下。

陈卫东则问道：“彪哥，那大概需要多长时间？”

彪哥也如实的将需要的时间说明了，“至少也得十天半个月吧。”

陈卫东一听得要十天半个月，觉得这时间就拖得有些久了。

现在制衣厂在赶生产呢，这要是拖个十天半个月，到时候得损失不少钱。

彪哥这边估计行不通了，陈卫东便打算自己进别墅空间，从网上下单缝纫机。

网上二手交易平台上的缝纫机价格不贵，一台也只有百八十块，就是运费稍微地贵一点，一台算下来，二百块以内能搞定。

Page (1/3)

Seeing her son roaring in such a hurry, Zhang Shufen asked: "Weidong, are you so anxious? Can't you go to the county seat tomorrow?"

It's getting late now, why don't we go there tomorrow?"

Chen Weidong couldn't wait and said, "Mom, there's enough time. I'll ride faster and I'll be back in time for dinner.

It's better to get this done sooner, so I can feel more at ease."

Seeing her son say this, Zhang Shufen stopped stopping him.

"You're such a hothead, kid.

I thought you had become more stable during this period, but I didn't expect that you are still a little impatient sometimes."

Chen Weidong smiled and said: "Mom, there is no way. Isn't this trying to help our Hongqi production team earn more money?"

Their family lived a good life, and Chen Weidong also wanted to lead the team to get rich together.

This is good for his family and the entire production team.

After listening to her son's words, Zhang Shufen couldn't help but reveal a proud smile on her face.

The son she raised was not only outstanding in ability, but also in character.

As a mother, she felt very pleased and proud.

Chen Weidong rode his bicycle and rushed towards the county seat quickly.

After arriving at the county seat, Chen Weidong went to see Brother Biao after changing his usual clothes.

Coincidentally, Chen Weidong sold the more than 100 kilograms of wild boar meat that was not sold yesterday to Brother Biao.

After the wild boar meat was sold out, Chen Weidong and Brother Biao brought up the sewing machine.

He needs five sewing machines this time. I wonder if Brother Biao can get them.

"Brother, I can help you get five sewing machines, but it may take some time." Brother Biao explained the situation.

Chen Weidong asked: "Brother Biao, how long will it take?"

Brother Biao also explained the time required truthfully, "It will take at least ten days and a half."

When Chen Weidong heard that it would take ten days and a half, he felt that this time was dragging on for a long time.

Now the garment factory is rushing to produce. If it takes ten days and a half, a lot of money will be lost by then.

Brother Biao probably couldn't do it here, so Chen Weidong planned to enter the villa space by himself and place an order for a sewing machine online.

The sewing machines on the online second-hand trading platform are not expensive. One machine only costs 180 yuan. However, the shipping fee is a little more expensive. Calculating one machine, you can get it within 200 yuan.
